description: This file defines a React functional component 'SlidePreview' that renders a preview for different types of slides or pages in a presentation builder application. It includes logic for various modes such as cover, last page, skill factory slide, and normal slides, and references external theme presets and images. It also includes a utility function for normalizing multiline text.
